parity_gaps.summary: No licensed, row-level external benchmark denominator is pinned, so SemiAnalysis-equivalent recall, precision, and feature parity are not computed.
The source registry, structural shortlist, footprint context, and satellite queue do not establish complete global construction coverage.
Several potentially useful commercial, interconnection, utility, parcel, and permit lanes lack verified rights for row-level public redistribution.
Unknown008 remains incomplete with 5,886 pending catalog jobs, and the 21 frozen analyst reviews do not exhaust candidate-level manual verification.
Within-release links remain advisory, cross-source deduplication is not accepted, and unique physical sites remain null.
Data-centre type, operating model, capacity, power, annual energy, PUE, and workload fields remain sparse and source-scoped; no missing values are inferred.
